verdict.rationale: LiteLLM documents a single completion() interface for any provider, with every response normalized to the OpenAI Chat Completions format across 100+ LLMs. Independent community posts corroborate its use to standardize different AI APIs, and a maintainer confirmed streaming and function-calling work the same way as the openai-python SDK. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that provider-specific features behave uniformly across the full provider list (the streaming/function-calling parity claim comes from the maintainer).

support.subject: As a developer, I can call many model providers through one consistent API

citations.quote: Call any provider using the same completion() interface, with no API to re-learn for each one
Every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format, regardless of provider.
Drop-in OpenAI compatibility — swap providers without rewriting your code
Consistent output format regardless of which provider or model you use
